WASHINGTON

March 17, 1961

My dear Professor WiUcox: ,
.

I have learned with greatest pleasure of your one
hundredth birthday on March 22nd. I want to extend
to you my warmest greetings as well as the thanks
of this government for the many special services you
have performed over your long career. I know that
the study of economics and statistics in this country
and the application of new statistical techniques to

public policy have benefited enormously from your
work. I hope that you will have a most enjoyable day.

May I also tell you how pleased I am. that your son is

serving in my Administration as General Counsel of
the Department of Health, Education and Welfare.

With all good wishes,

Sincerely,

Professor W. F. Wilicox

Ithaca, New York
